render.baseFont: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

rules: Text is FluentText, its type set by Size and Weight: TextSize.Size100 10/14, Size200 12/16, Size300 14/20, Size400 16/22, Size500 20/28, Size600 24/32, Size700 28/36, Size800 32/40; TextWeight.Regular 400, Medium 500, Semibold 600, Bold 700. Give a heading its tag with As="TextTag.H2" (paragraphs As="TextTag.Paragraph"). When no size matches the design exactly, take the nearest.

Spacing goes in {name}.razor.css with Fluent's tokens: var(--spacingVerticalS, 8px), var(--spacingHorizontalL, 16px) (XXS 2, XS 4, SNudge 6, S 8, MNudge 10, M 12, L 16, XL 20, XXL 24, XXXL 28). Lay out with display: flex and gap on plain elements; FluentStack's gap parameters take literal sizes, which are hard-coded.

Colours are Fluent's tokens: var(--colorNeutralForeground1, #242424) for text, var(--colorNeutralForeground2, #424242) for secondary text, var(--colorNeutralBackground1, #ffffff) for surfaces, var(--colorNeutralStroke1, #d1d1d1) for borders, var(--colorBrandBackground, #0f6cbd) for the brand.

Form fields carry their own label: <FluentTextInput Label="Email" TextInputType="TextInputType.Email" @bind-Value="email" />, <FluentCheckbox Label="Remember me" @bind-Value="remember" />. Buttons: <FluentButton Appearance="ButtonAppearance.Primary" Type="ButtonType.Submit">.
